kibicomputers.configuration.title: KiBi Computers Configuration
kibicomputers.configuration.scheduler.to: Threads and server-wide limits. Changes take effect when the world is next opened.
kibicomputers.configuration.scheduler.ma: Maximum number of computers running WebAssembly at the same time. 0 = automatic (half of the CPU threads, at least 1).
kibicomputers.configuration.scheduler.th: Stack size of each kernel thread, in KiB. Only reserved; memory is used as needed.
kibicomputers.configuration.scheduler.ma: Maximum number of blocking processes (each uses a dedicated thread) on the whole server.
Maximum number of one owner's computers running WebAssembly at the same time. 0 = no limit (owners still take turns).
Maximum number of blocking processes of one owner's computers. 0 = no limit.
Maximum number of programs one owner's computers may have waiting to load. Startup and restore are not refused. 0 = no limit.
kibicomputers.configuration.scheduler.co: Number of low-priority threads that load (instrument and compile) programs.
kibicomputers.configuration.scheduler.pr: Number of loaded programs kept in memory even when no computer uses them.
Total WebAssembly size of the unused programs kept in memory, in MiB.
kibicomputers.configuration.scheduler.to: Total RAM limit for all computers on the server, in MiB. 0 = automatic (half of the maximum JVM heap).
kibicomputers.configuration.save.autosav: Interval between autosaves of running computers, in ticks. Raised to at least autosaveQuiesceTicks + 2 (a shorter interval would close computers before they are written).
Ticks an autosave waits for a computer to reach a safe point.
Maximum number of computers captured for autosave per tick.
kibicomputers.configuration.save.unloadW: Total time per tick spent waiting for computers in unloading chunks to reach a safe point, in milliseconds.
kibicomputers.configuration.save.stopQui: Time the server waits on shutdown for all computers to reach a safe point, in milliseconds.
kibicomputers.configuration.save.fullSav: Write a full save instead of a delta when more than this fraction of the rewritten pages changed from the base.

Write a delta regardless of the threshold when at most this many 4 KiB pages changed from the base. Pages of processes not in the base (started after it, or after a restore) are not counted as under this limit: the threshold decides, so a full save can give them a base. 0 uses the threshold alone.
kibicomputers.configuration.save.writerM: Maximum total size of saves waiting to be written, in MiB. Above this, autosaves are postponed.
kibicomputers.configuration.save.writerF: Maximum time to wait for the save writer thread (on shutdown and when the pending limit is reached), in milliseconds.
kibicomputers.configuration.save.restore: Maximum number of computers whose restore starts per tick when chunks load.
Maximum time a restore waits for a pending save of the same computer; after that it cold-boots, in milliseconds.
kibicomputers.configuration.screenSync.p: Maximum screen update traffic sent to one player, in bytes per second.
kibicomputers.configuration.screenSync.s: Maximum screen update traffic sent to all players together, in bytes per second.
kibicomputers.configuration.screenSync.o: Maximum screen update traffic from the screens of one owner's computers, in bytes per second. 0 = no limit.
kibicomputers.configuration.keyboard.inp: Burst size of keyboard input a computer accepts, in bytes. Applies to keyboards opened after a change.
Keyboard input allowance restored per tick, in bytes. Applies to keyboards opened after a change.
message.kibicomputers.access.denied_lock: This computer's owner could not be read; only operators can use it
kibicomputers.configuration.access.opPer: Players with at least this permission level can use, break and manage computers owned by others.
kibicomputers.configuration.access.pendi: Hours a member added by name waits for that player to use the computer before it expires.
kibicomputers.configuration.access.maxMe: Maximum number of members of one computer.
kibicomputers.configuration.access.maxPe: Maximum number of members added by name that are still waiting, per computer.
message.kibicomputers.access.request.unk: There is no such request, or you cannot decide it
message.kibicomputers.access.request.pla: Only players can decide computer requests
message.kibicomputers.access.request.app: Approved: %s will become a member when they next use the computer (%s)
message.kibicomputers.access.request.rea: the owner record could not be read
kibicomputers.configuration.access.reque: Seconds a change requested by a program on a computer waits for the owner or an operator to approve it.
kibicomputers.configuration.access.maxRe: Maximum number of change requests from one computer that are waiting for approval.
message.kibicomputers.saves.cleanup.busy: The computer save cleanup is already running or computer saves are not available
message.kibicomputers.saves.cleanup.none: The computer save cleanup has not run on this server
message.kibicomputers.runtime.interprete: WASM compilations that fell back to the interpreter (since the game started), by reason: %s
Processes started from programs with interpreted code (this server), by reason: %s
#%s: machine %s at %s (id %s): %s processes, reasons %s, last program SHA-256 %s…
…and %s more computers (give a reason and a limit, up to 1000, to list more)
No loaded computer has started a program with interpreted code
No loaded computer has started a program with interpreted code for the reason %s
Unknown reason '%s'. Use all or one of: %s
kibicomputers.configuration.reboot.toolt: Waits before a computer that keeps rebooting starts again. Changes take effect when the world is next opened.
kibicomputers.configuration.machine.tool: Limits of each computer. Changes apply to computers powered on or loaded afterwards; lowering them can make saved computers cold-boot.
kibicomputers.configuration.cpu.tooltip: Performance of each CPU tier. Changes apply to computers powered on or loaded afterwards.
kibicomputers.configuration.memory.toolt: Capacity of each RAM tier. Changes apply to computers powered on or loaded afterwards; lowering them can make saved computers cold-boot.
kibicomputers.configuration.storage.tool: Capacity of each disk tier. Changes apply to disks inserted or computers powered on afterwards; files are kept when lowered.
kibicomputers.configuration.scheduler.ma: Time per tick the server thread spends on computer notifications and world calls, in microseconds. The rest waits for later ticks.
kibicomputers.configuration.scheduler.ho: Maximum number of disk files kept open by all computers on the server together.
kibicomputers.configuration.reboot.freeR: Number of quick reboots a computer may make without waiting.
kibicomputers.configuration.reboot.baseD: First wait before a reboot after the free ones, in ticks. Doubles with each further quick reboot.
kibicomputers.configuration.reboot.maxDe: Longest wait before a reboot, in ticks. Raised to at least decayTicks.
kibicomputers.configuration.reboot.decay: Ticks a computer must run to earn back one quick reboot. In the long run, each computer reboots at most once per this many ticks.
kibicomputers.configuration.reboot.capLe: Most levels of reboot debt kept. Raised so the wait can reach maxDelayTicks.
kibicomputers.configuration.machine.maxP: Maximum number of processes on one computer.
kibicomputers.configuration.machine.maxB: Maximum number of blocking processes (each uses a dedicated thread) on one computer.
kibicomputers.configuration.machine.maxH: Maximum number of world calls (device calls and the like) one computer runs on the server thread per tick.
kibicomputers.configuration.machine.maxE: Maximum number of event queues on one computer.
kibicomputers.configuration.machine.maxP: Maximum total size of undelivered events held by one computer, in KiB.
kibicomputers.configuration.machine.maxA: Maximum number of running timers on one computer.
kibicomputers.configuration.machine.host: Maximum number of disk files one computer keeps open.
kibicomputers.configuration.machine.cons: Console input buffer of one computer (typed and unread input), in KiB. Applies when a computer cold-boots.
Console output buffer of one computer, in KiB. Programs wait when it is full. Applies when a computer cold-boots.
kibicomputers.configuration.machine.maxP: Maximum console output of one computer waiting to be shown, in KiB. Output beyond this is dropped.
kibicomputers.configuration.cpu.tier1Fue: Fuel (WebAssembly instructions, roughly) per tick of a tier 1 CPU.
kibicomputers.configuration.cpu.tier1Max: Number of devices a computer with a tier 1 CPU can connect (the case speaker counts as one).
kibicomputers.configuration.memory.tier1: Capacity of one tier 1 RAM module, in MiB. A computer's total RAM is capped at 4096 MiB.
kibicomputers.configuration.storage.tier: Capacity of one tier 1 disk, in MiB. Lowering it does not delete files; writes that would grow a fuller disk are refused.
Maximum number of files and directories on one tier 1 disk.
kibicomputers.configuration.cpu.tier2Fue: Fuel (WebAssembly instructions, roughly) per tick of a tier 2 CPU.
kibicomputers.configuration.cpu.tier2Max: Number of devices a computer with a tier 2 CPU can connect (the case speaker counts as one).
kibicomputers.configuration.memory.tier2: Capacity of one tier 2 RAM module, in MiB. A computer's total RAM is capped at 4096 MiB.
kibicomputers.configuration.storage.tier: Capacity of one tier 2 disk, in MiB. Lowering it does not delete files; writes that would grow a fuller disk are refused.
Maximum number of files and directories on one tier 2 disk.
kibicomputers.configuration.cpu.tier3Fue: Fuel (WebAssembly instructions, roughly) per tick of a tier 3 CPU.
kibicomputers.configuration.cpu.tier3Max: Number of devices a computer with a tier 3 CPU can connect (the case speaker counts as one).
kibicomputers.configuration.memory.tier3: Capacity of one tier 3 RAM module, in MiB. A computer's total RAM is capped at 4096 MiB.
kibicomputers.configuration.storage.tier: Capacity of one tier 3 disk, in MiB. Lowering it does not delete files; writes that would grow a fuller disk are refused.
Maximum number of files and directories on one tier 3 disk.
kibicomputers.configuration.cpu.tier4Fue: Fuel (WebAssembly instructions, roughly) per tick of a tier 4 CPU.
kibicomputers.configuration.cpu.tier4Max: Number of devices a computer with a tier 4 CPU can connect (the case speaker counts as one).
kibicomputers.configuration.memory.tier4: Capacity of one tier 4 RAM module, in MiB. A computer's total RAM is capped at 4096 MiB.
kibicomputers.configuration.storage.tier: Capacity of one tier 4 disk, in MiB. Lowering it does not delete files; writes that would grow a fuller disk are refused.
Maximum number of files and directories on one tier 4 disk.
kibicomputers.configuration.cpu.creative: Fuel (WebAssembly instructions, roughly) per tick of a creative CPU.
Number of devices a computer with a creative CPU can connect (the case speaker counts as one).
kibicomputers.configuration.memory.creat: Capacity of one creative RAM module, in MiB. A computer's total RAM is capped at 4096 MiB.
kibicomputers.configuration.storage.crea: Capacity of one creative disk, in MiB. Lowering it does not delete files; writes that would grow a fuller disk are refused.
Maximum number of files and directories on one creative disk.
